references.text: Here is described the very act where Abimelech killed his seventy brothers on one stone, for which God now punishes him.
The verse explains that violence against Jerubbaal's seventy sons would be repaid, and their blood would come upon Abimelech.
The principle that a person reaps what they sow, and that evil returns to the one who commits it.
Whoever digs a pit for others falls into it themselves – the principle of retribution for evil.
Bloodguilt defiles the land and can only be atoned for by the blood of the one who shed it – God's righteous judgment on murder.
The principle that what a person sows, they will also reap – God's righteous retribution.
